caption: The drawing depicts a pouch-like object composed of four triangular panels, arranged symmetrically to form a diamond shape, with the top two panels being parallel to the bottom two. The left half of the pouch consists primarily of red tones with white accents, and the right half features mostly white tones with red accents. Both sides have stitched seams with patterns of small, regularly spaced short lines in blue and brown, as well as decorative diamond or oval shapes at the corners where the panels meet. In the center of each bottom panel, there is a swirling, backward 'S'-shaped motif outlined and filled in yellow on the right and brown on the left. Two cords run horizontally across the top of the pouch with small, round decorations at the center. A thin, twisted cord is attached at the top, ending in two fluffy pom-poms. The bottom of the pouch is adorned with a multi-colored tassel consisting of red, yellow, and white threads. The background is plain, off-white with no additional objects or elements. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Bag
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
